comment: I had Carlos for Spanish in the Community.  The 20 hour volunteering requirement is hard to fit in, but the class itself is pretty easy.  He is a really cool and relaxed professor but is hard grader because he actually wants you to learn the material.

Valenica is markedly unhelpful. He does not respect personal space. Also, this class' demands of community based service are difficult for anyone with a busy schedule, particularly those of theatre majors and athletes. His grading is inconsistent and less than helpful.
I had him for Spanish in the Community, and for spanish in the media.  He's a great teacher. Prob the best spanish teacher at UR. Plus, he actually understands the plight of a college kid.

I love Valencia as a teacher. He's always willing to help and easily available. He adds his own little stories and life to every class discussion which is cool at times, but also a little awkward. All in al great teacher, but he's a very heavy grader on writing. He likes his sentences to be written a very specific way!
Too much english spoken in class, I didn't really learn a lot, but he is HOTT
He's a nice professor, very willing to help his students. his class is fun, but grades could be lower than expected
Watch out for grading. He often looses your papers and then makes up a lower grade. I have had him for 4 classes so I know what I am talking about!

Carlos is a good teacher and creates good discussions but doesn't lead them very well. He's passionate about what he teaches but he also makes unnecessary comments. Pretty easy grader, but for papers he is very specific which makes grading difficult. Overall, good but not great teacher.
Too much English spoken in class.

I'm taking Spanish just out of interest but he's making me loving it! Assignments are due online everyday and grading is okay. He's very fun in class and (as someone else said) verrrrrrrrry hot! I'm definitely taking him again and I'd recommend him to anyone!

Carlos is a fantastic teacher, his grading isn't too tough and he is really encouraging. He's also really funny, and he initiates all the conversations. If you participate in class, do the homework and know a little spanish you are basically guaranteed a B. I would DEFINITELY recommend this class!

He's really a great teacher. Like everyone else said, he's very creative and definitely fun in class. I thought his grading was way too picky at times, and it really frustrated me!!! Still, he's a super cool guy over all, and uber hip. I definitely recommend him... just do your homework every night and go to class even though it's not mandatory!!

He assigns homework everynight but it usually doesnt take too long to do. He is kind of a hard grader but totally worth it. In discussions he initiates topics and they are always interesting. I definately recommend taking him!!!!

I took him for 221 and 303 and plan on taking him again for 311.  I like him a lot, but some people hate him.  I think he's a lot of fun and is very helpful and encouraging, others just get discouraged by the work.
Carlos is tough. but fun and hot!

He is very inventive in the way that he presents topic in Spanish. It is a lot of work though and he is a pretty strict grader. But if you pay attention in class and study you will get a decent grade. I got a B!
Great professor! I learned so much in this class. He doesnt just teach but he uses things like songs, Battleship, and other games to make Spanish interesting. TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!
